subject: if-st-dy
title: IF.ST.DY.------MTA.IMP.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 77 (WAM-19). IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; MTA-IMP (meta-implications), also with the (C) prefix, is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: AF-TD (affinity tendencies), DYM-SPI and CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From AF-TD: PART (participation) and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From DYM-SPI: LK-IMP (linkage implications). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is on a dotted line from DYM-SPI. From PROG-CONT: EXP-CONT (expansion condition). JR-DY (journalism dynamics) is on a dotted line from CULT-INFO-F.
